title: hive-pool answer-question: request body
description: Records one answer exactly as given against a question, its card and its round at their revisions, and applies it in the same transaction: releases the hold, completes the question, defers it, or records it unreconciled when the question has moved on. Two answers with the same source are one answer: the second returns the first's receipt and writes nothing. The operation word persists answers through. Refused with authority_insufficient unless the request is made by the hive-word command of the package word, on a hive-word request: the caller names that command and the envelope's causation is the hive-word request, schema hive.request, with its request_id and the digest of its canonical form.

card.description: The card the answer was given on, with the card, question, held item and decision round at the revisions the Hive Mind was shown. They are recorded with the answer as what was shown. Only the question revision and the card revision are grounds to treat the answer as changed: an answer to one card of a round never makes another card of the same round stale.

text.description: The free text exactly as given. Empty only when an option was chosen or Later was chosen; an answer holds an option, or Later, or text that is not empty, and an answer with none of the three is invalid and applies nothing.

source.description: The evidence the answer rests on, required: a review submission, a session input or an operator request. See the answer_source of records/pool.question.v1.

supersedes.description: The sequence of an earlier applied answer this one replaces. Requires the envelope's authority to be the Hive Mind's word or an operator request as the answer's source.

reconciles.description: The sequence of an unreconciled answer this one settles at the current revision.
